title: Towards Robust ESG Analysis Against Greenwashing Risks: Aspect-Action Analysis with Cross-Category Generalization
reasoning: The paper focuses on ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) analysis, specifically identifying sustainability aspects and associated actions to detect greenwashing. While ESG includes ethical standards like business compliance and social responsibility, the paper focuses on the technical robustness of NLP models in extracting these claims rather than evaluating or benchmarking moral reasoning, religious values, or faith-based frameworks.
